goal: Defeat Team Rocket in Silph Co.

subgoals.goal_text: Travel from Vermilion City to Saffron City.
Enter the Silph Co. building in Saffron City.
Fight through the first floor of Silph Co. to reach the elevator.
Use the elevator to move through the floors of Silph Co., defeating Rocket Grunts along the way.
Navigate to the top floor of Silph Co. and locate Giovanni.
Defeat Giovanni in battle to liberate Silph Co.
